rds.details: New accounts (since July 15, 2025): Free plan up to 6 months, $100 credits at sign-up plus up to $100 more from activities ($200 total); RDS Free plan on db.t3.micro / db.t4g.micro for PostgreSQL; account closes after 6 months or when credits run out unless converted to Paid. Accounts opened before July 15, 2025 keep the legacy 12-month free tier (pricing page text: 750 hours Single-AZ, 20 GB gp2, 20 GB backups).

aurora.details: Free plan (new accounts, up to 6 months, shares the $100-$200 AWS credits): Aurora PostgreSQL 'up to 4 Aurora Capacity Units (ACU) and 1 GiB of storage per cluster'. Aurora DSQL is listed as always free (100k DPU and 1 GiB per month), but DSQL is not Aurora PostgreSQL.

cloudsql.details: No always-free Cloud SQL. New Google Cloud customers get $300 in free credits. Separate Cloud SQL free trial instance: 30 days, Enterprise Plus edition, 8 vCPUs and 64 GB memory (N2), 100 GB storage; stops serving at the end, 90-day grace period; one per new project.

azure.details: 12 months free for new Azure customers: '750 hours of Flexible Server - Burstable B1MS Instance, 32 GB storage, and 32 GB backup storage'. Free account also gives '$200 credit to use on Azure services within 30 days'.

digitalocean.details: No free managed database plan listed on the pricing page. Pricing FAQ only mentions an example promotional credit ('if you received a $5 credit for 90 days').

supabase.details: Free $0: 500 MB database size, Shared CPU and 500 MB RAM, 5 GB egress, 1 GB file storage, limit of 2 active projects, 'Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity.' No backups or PITR.

neon.details: Free $0, no time limit, no card: 100 projects, 100 CU-hours monthly per project, 1 GB storage per project, sizes up to 2 CU (8 GB RAM), scale to zero after 5 minutes inactive, restore window up to 6 hours or 1 GB of changes.

crunchy.details: No free plan on the Crunchy pricing page; cheapest Hobby-0 is $9/month. Hobby plans 'do not support High availability standbys'.

aiven.details: Free $0: 1 CPU, 1 GB RAM, 1 GB storage, cannot select cloud/region, no connection pooling. 'Free services do not have any time limitations' but are powered off with no initial usage in the first few hours or no continued activity (notice sent first).

planetscale.details: No free plan listed for Postgres; cheapest is single-node PS-5 at $5/month.

xata.details: 'Is there a free tier? No. Our core platform is available under Apache 2.0. Xata Cloud offers a free trial.' Trial length not stated.

tembo.details: No hosted Postgres product today; tembo.io now sells a cloud coding-agent product.
